business.name: Rootshare
business.summary: A neighborhood seed library where gardeners borrow and contribute seeds to a shared local collection.
business.audience: Neighborhood gardeners identifying the service in its favicon, app icon or social avatar.

design_direction.intended_appearance: A deliberately constructed matte terracotta object with a restrained pale ceramic accent only where it serves hierarchy or construction. Resolve primary contours, junctions, edge profiles and material contacts. Fine clay response supports the form at hero scale. The same primary identity must work in flat form.

references.note: The reference's blue seal and raised gold lettering/check have controlled relief and reflective highlights. Judge the care of its own construction; its styling is not the candidate's design.
The reference's blue seal and gold lettering/check have a glossy reflective finish with rounded relief. Judge its own intended construction; gloss is not a universal quality target.

requirements.communication_priority: A welcoming resource held in common, supported by grounded care. This is a proposed positioning direction, not a new business fact.

facts.claim: Rootshare is a neighborhood seed library; gardeners borrow and contribute seeds to a shared local collection.
Whether borrowers must return seeds, and whether provenance tracking exists, is unknown.

requirements.claim: Required output uses: favicon, app_icon and social_avatar.
Prioritize the impression of a welcoming resource held in common, without requiring the symbol to explain the complete service.
Explore matte terracotta and pale ceramic as the fixture's current material direction; shape, lettering and assembly remain open.
Flat exports and 3D components use the same primary motif contours.

concept.metaphor_text: Complementary forms define one shared, retained interior
concept.treatment_text: The mark itself as a solid object with depth and softly beveled edges, standing free with no backing.
concept.material_text: Soft modeling clay with a matte, hand-made look.
concept.source: authored flat development study; not an eligibility selection

plan.hypothesis: Complementary forms define one shared, retained interior
plan.visual_mechanism: Complementary forms define one shared, retained interior
assumptions: The intended communication is a design hypothesis, not a new service fact

details.purpose: Both forms define one recognizable interior rather than two unrelated ornaments
details.construction: Two separately made ceramic forms retain the same master contours; no unsupported physical interlock is claimed
details.deletion_test: Removing either form opens and unbalances the common interior

details.purpose: Resolve the two gaps and material thickness deliberately
details.construction: Controlled outer handling radius with a finer inner lip, continuous matte ceramic surfaces
details.deletion_test: Uniform raw extrusion loses the deliberate edge hierarchy
